covenant.quote: Permit the Consolidated Interest Coverage Ratio as of the end of any fiscal quarter of Holdings to be less than 3.00 to 1.00.

thresholds.quote: Permit the Consolidated Interest Coverage Ratio as of the end of any fiscal quarter of Holdings to be less than 3.00 to 1.00.

earlier_versions.quote: Permit the Consolidated Interest Coverage Ratio as of the end of any fiscal quarter of Holdings to be less than 3.00 to 1.00.

evidence.quote: the ratio of (a) Consolidated Funded Indebtedness (net of (i) Unrestricted Cash of Holdings and its Subsidiaries (other than any Subsidiary organized under the laws of Brazil) not exceeding $100,000,000 plus (ii) the Unrestricted Cash of a Subsidiary organized under the laws of Brazil) to (b) Consolidated EBITDA for the most recently completed Measurement Period.

terms.label: Unrestricted Cash

evidence.quote: Unrestricted Cash of Holdings and its Subsidiaries (other than any Subsidiary organized under the laws of Brazil) not exceeding $100,000,000

terms.cap_note: $100,000,000 cap applies to non-Brazil Unrestricted Cash only; Brazil Unrestricted Cash netted without cap

definition_evidence.quote: "Unrestricted Cash" means, as of any date of determination, the aggregate amount of cash and Cash Equivalents properly classified as "unrestricted cash" for purposes of GAAP as at such date

terms.label: Consolidated Funded Indebtedness
children_labels: obligations for borrowed money and obligations evidenced by bonds, debentures, notes, loan agreements or similar instruments
direct non-contingent obligations under letters of credit, bankers' acceptances, bank guaranties, surety bonds
deferred purchase price of property or services
Attributable Indebtedness in respect of Capital Leases and Synthetic Lease Obligations
Guarantees of such Indebtedness of other Persons
such Indebtedness of partnerships or joint ventures

evidence.quote: "Consolidated Funded Indebtedness" means, as of any date of determination, for Holdings and its Subsidiaries on a consolidated basis, the sum of (a) the outstanding principal amount of all obligations as determined in accordance with GAAP, whether current or long-term, for borrowed money

terms.label: Consolidated EBITDA
children_labels: provision for income and franchise taxes
non-recurring non-cash expenses, write-offs, write-downs or impairment charges
cash severance, restructuring, retention and integration charges
one-time Permitted Acquisition advisory, financing, legal, accounting and consulting expenses

evidence.quote: "Consolidated EBITDA" means, at any date of determination, an amount equal to Consolidated Net Income of Holdings and its Subsidiaries on a consolidated basis for the most recently completed Measurement Period, plus the following, without duplication, to the extent deducted in calculating such Consolidated Net Income: (a) consolidated interest expense

evidence_subtractions.quote: and minus, without duplication, (x) any amount included in Consolidated EBITDA for such Measurement Period in respect of cancellation of debt income

terms.label: cash severance, restructuring, retention and integration charges

evidence.quote: in an amount not to exceed, in the case of this clause (i), 15.0% of Consolidated EBITDA for such Measurement Period
exceed in the case of this clause (ii), $5,000,000

the aggregate amount of cost savings additions made pursuant to this clause (C) in any four consecutive fiscal quarter period shall not exceed 10% of Consolidated EBITDA for such period prior to giving effect to this clause (C)

terms.label: Consolidated Net Income

evidence.quote: "Consolidated Net Income" means, at any date of determination, the net income (or loss) of Holdings and its Subsidiaries on a consolidated basis for the most recently completed Measurement Period

terms.note: Base net income with exclusions (extraordinary items, pension withdrawal charges, restricted subsidiary income, non-subsidiary income, etc.) not itemized

terms.label: Consolidated Cash Interest Expense
children_labels: consolidated interest expense payable in cash

evidence.quote: "Consolidated Cash Interest Expense" means, for any Measurement Period, consolidated interest expense payable in cash in such period (including that portion attributable to Capital Leases in accordance with GAAP and capitalized interest)

"Consolidated Interest Coverage Ratio" means, as of any date of determination, the ratio of (a) Consolidated EBITDA for the most recently completed Measurement Period to (b) Consolidated Cash Interest Expense
